decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The setup of the suspension has been changed while under Parc Ferme. The front wing specification has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: Oracle Red Bull Racing changed the setup of the suspension of Car 22 under Parc Ferme, this not being in accordance with Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. Car 22 is therefore required to start the Race from pit lane. Oracle Red Bull Racing changed the rear wing specification of Car 22 under Parc Ferme with the approval of the Technical Delegate in accordance with Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. However, the assembly is of a different specification, which is a breach of Article 40.9 and Car 22 is required to start the Race from pit lane.
rules_referenced: Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 22 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
